videos.title: #1 Couples Therapist: If You Catch This Early, You Can Save Your Relationship | Dr. Orna Guralnik
videos.description:
Couples that never argue aren't the strongest, they're often the most afraid. Real strength is knowing how to face your differences and move through them together.

In this clip, Dr. Orna Guralnik and Jay Shetty break down what actually marks a healthy relationship, why the "we never argue" metric is a red flag, and what happens when you stop blaming your partner and start looking at yourself.

Dr. Guralnik shares why couples get stuck in the blame game, what it means when "otherness" triggers you, and how to create a safe space where both people feel cared for rather than wrong. You'll learn why trying to change your partner usually reveals something you're working through about yourself, and why the couples doing the deepest work together aren't the ones avoiding conflict, they're the ones moving through it.

Learn why the difference between you and your partner isn't the problem, how you respond to that difference is.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

videos.description:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Sam Harris, PhD, a neuroscientist, bestselling author, and world-renowned meditation teacher whose work focuses on consciousness, ethics, and religion. We discuss how meditation can help us better understand the nature of the self and transform the conscious experience. Sam also explains how meditation can help overcome universal challenges such as distractibility, mental chatter and emotional reactivity, which can allow for greater focus and fulfillment in the present moment.

videos.description: Alex's Content Machine pulls from a personal voice guide that captures his top-performing posts, hook formulas, content structures, and even specific language patterns like "self-deprecating confidence." When the system drafts, it's drafting against his actual voice, not the average of the internet.

videos.title: The Dunning-Kruger Effect
videos.description:
Idiots are certain. Smart people are full of doubt. Calibrated confidence requires enough knowledge to actually see the gaps, which means the more you learn, the more uncertain you often feel.

Watch the full episode here: https://mrk.mn/H8cVFPf.
